# Gold Volatility Forecasting

This group project has two active analysis stages: Stage 1 tests 11 LSEG
predictors against next-valid Yang-Zhang volatility, and Stage 2 compares
Yang-Zhang volatility forecasts. The input is LSEG GCc1 generic COMEX gold
futures, not spot or a single fixed-expiry contract. Preserve forecast-origin
availability and distinguish training-only inference from holdout evaluation.

- [Project overview](README.md) and [reproduction steps](REPRODUCE.md).
- [Predictor screen](src/gold_vol_pipeline/yang_zhang_significance.py) and
  [screen script](scripts/screen_yang_zhang_predictors.py).
- [Yang-Zhang target](src/gold_vol_pipeline/yang_zhang.py),
  [forecasting](src/gold_vol_pipeline/volatility_forecasting.py), and
  [evaluation script](scripts/evaluate_yang_zhang_volatility.py).
- [Results report](reports/yang-zhang-volatility.qmd).
- [AI handoff protocol](.ai/README.md), [session log](.ai/SESSION_LOG.md),
  [agent instructions](AGENTS.md), and [Git workflow](GIT_WORKFLOW.md).
